steps.text: Generously butter the insides of four 5 ½-ounce ramekins.
Whisk egg yolks, eggs, and sugar together in a bowl with an electric mixer until foamy and lighter in color.
Melt chocolate and butter in a microwave-safe bowl in 30-second intervals until melted, stirring after each interval, 1 to 3 minutes.
Stir melted chocolate mixture into egg and sugar mixture until combined. Sift in cocoa powder and stir to combine. Sift in flour and salt; stir to combine into a batter. Stir in vanilla.

Transfer batter to a resealable plastic bag. Snip off one corner of the bag with scissors to create a tip. Divide batter evenly between the prepared ramekins; gently tap ramekins on the counter to remove any air bubbles. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
Arrange chilled ramekins in a casserole dish. Pour enough warm tap water into the casserole dish to reach halfway up the sides of the ramekins.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool for 15 minutes.
Loosen the edges from each ramekin with a knife. Invert cakes onto serving plates and dust with powdered sugar.

review.reviewBody: I had a similar old recipe which I love, but then I tried to follow this recipe, just change a little bit of the way to melt the chocolate (I melted it on a steamer, beware of the condensation, and just melted it halfway then continue mix the mixture with spoon until completely melted, so it will not be lumpy). I served it in the ramekins, because the top of my cake was cracked, so I thought it will look cool just like that. And I served it with vanilla ice cream, perfect!! If you love chocolate then you'll love this recipe, I for sure will make it again and again. Picture uploaded :)

This was so good!! I made it as written, but I had 7.5oz ramekins, so it made 3 instead of 4. Also, instead of scooping it out of the dish & adding icing sugar, I left them in the ramekins & added a scoop of butter pecan ice cream. Hubby said it was the best Chocolate Lava Cake he ever had!!

My favorite lava cake recipe! So rich and decadent! If anyone is complaining they didn't have a gooey center, you over baked it. The key to getting them perfect is making sure the eggs and sugar are beaten very well until thickened and foamy. I used a stand mixer to beat while I got every thing else ready. Also, make sure you refrigerate as the directions state! I just refrigerate batter earlier in the day so it's ready to bake come dessert time! I found mine were perfect when the edges were firm and the center when pressed on was firm enough that your finger didn't go into the center of the cake but when pressed on you could feel that the inside was "jiggly".
I find if you add just 1/8 teaspoon of coffee extract, it punches up the flavor a lot.

I made a double recipe (6 cakes), with 7 oz of 70% dark artisan chocolate bars, and Belgian powdered chocolate. I forgot to add the water to the dish that I placed the ramikens in until they had cooked for 10 minutes, then added the water and cooked for an extra 4 minutes. They turned out great - everyone loved it served with Vanilla ice cream.

This was lovely! For those saying the outcome was like a brownie, I have a couple of hints. Don't skimp on beating the eggs. The egg and sugar mixture must be light and thick. After the 15 minute baking, take the ramekins out of the water beefier letting them stand. Mine had a delicate texture with great "lava" and flavor.

This is a wonderful recipe. Made it to serve 60 but added another 30% to make the servings slightly larger. In my opinion reference should be made in the recipe to when it's done. Had it not been for some of the reviewers, I think I would have had a disaster. Anyway, I refrigerated the batter overnight, and my, it does thicken up. I used an ice cream scoop to dish it out, which worked really well - forget the baggie. They rose beautifully, like a souffle. Everyone was very impressed, served dusted with icing sugar, a sliced/fanned strawberry, and a dollop of whipped cream.

Nice recipe. I thought it was going to be too complicated, but it really wasn't. I made it exactly as written, only I didn't have the any ramekins. I used a 6pk cupcake tin and made 6 mini cakes. I cooked them for 12 minutes, which was too long. Next time I'd cook for 10. Even though... they were a little soft on the inside, but would have preferred them more runny.

Perfect! We grease ramekons with butter flavor shortening then use Hershey dark cocoa powder to powder coat shortening inside of ramekins. We cover iinsides in cocoa powder then gently bounce off excess and fill with batter as directed. Sooo delicious.

It turned out FANTASTIC! My only comments are to definitely use an electric mixer for the egg and sugar mixing and the recipe didn’t indicate which flour to use so I thought self rising would best- and it WAS.

Wow!! Made this for tonight's dessert. First time ever making Chocolate Lava Cakes. Followed the directions exactly, EXCEPT, chilled the ramekins for 20 minutes and baked for 17 minutes. Came out so delicious! Centers weren't runny, but very creamy. Definitely will try this again! Especially delicious with sliced strawberries and premium vanilla ice cream!!
So good! Make sure not to leave them in for too long or else you’ll miss the gooey center. I used half dark chocolate half semisweet.
Made in a heart shaped pans so had to lower the cooking time but it was excellent
Have used this recipe multiple times and the cakes turn out perfect each time! My kids love these and ask for them often. We follow directions as provided.
It was very dry and not very sweet. I would recommend cooking it for a shorter time.
I really enjoyed it! It was too dark "not sweet enough" for my husband. Heads up it is definitely a bit more of a dark chocolate flavor.
I need to make adjustments. Followed exact instructions and it wasn't gooey in the center, but it tasted good.
They came out exactly the way they should have ! I didn’t have powdered sugar but were delicious without . Chef John can do no wrong !
OMG! We often get the lava cake at Chili's and love it. Everyone said this one was BETTER!!
It was easy but I used 56 percent chocolate
